proven_findings.finding: Automatic lint issued uncancellable metadata and EXPLAIN reads after each debounced edit
proven_findings.evidence: Original QueryTab effect depended on queryText; original lint_query called projection_schema and session.explain with CancelToken::new; new automatic_lint_never_reads_the_database regression uses a Session that panics on every database operation and passes

proven_findings.finding: PostgreSQL explain catalog enrichment could wait indefinitely after the bounded preview and queried once per Seq Scan
proven_findings.evidence: Original per-scan loop reacquired state.lock without a deadline and used client.query directly; new query batches/deduplicates targets via bounded execute with the remaining 30-second budget

proven_findings.finding: A failed auxiliary CancelRequest transport unnecessarily destroyed a healthy PostgreSQL connection
proven_findings.evidence: Before fix failed_cancel_transport_preserves_completed_explain failed in 0.03s with failed CancelRequest closed the primary connection; after fix both analyze=false and analyze=true preserve connection and subsequent explain/ping succeed

proven_findings.finding: Cancellation grace expiry killed the entire shared plugin process without checking process health
proven_findings.evidence: Original deadline branch called Process::fail unconditionally; new withheld-cancel-reply regression completes Cancelled and both the original and sibling SQLite sessions still answer ping after an independent protocol handshake

proven_findings.finding: Diagnostic clearing on every edit caused layout movement
proven_findings.evidence: Original effect cleared diagnostics before each 300ms debounce; browser regression now verifies messages persist during 700ms debounce, stale results are ignored, old quick fixes are withheld, and editor bounding box stays identical

changes: Automatic lint is local syntax analysis; explicit expand-star refactoring and explain retain their database functionality
PostgreSQL enrichment is deduplicated and bounded; cancellation retries capped at three with a five-second execution/rollback cleanup deadline
A cancel transport error alone no longer closes the PostgreSQL connection; a connection that cannot finish execution/rollback within the cleanup deadline is still closed

Plugin request timeout first cancels that request; expired cancellation grace retires it and probes the dispatcher before terminating an actually unresponsive process; initial handshake failures retain previous behavior
QueryPlan cancels on query/session changes and unmount, ignores superseded results, exposes cancellation, and QueryTab no longer remounts it for every edit
QueryTab retains diagnostic messages, reserves fixed diagnostic space, and disables Run button morph animation
